verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt, and every agentic-commerce page has a fetchable .md version (also probed live). The docs tell agents to read these pages directly (the one-prompt 'Read https://docs.stripe.com/payments/machine/mpp.md…' build path) and add `link-cli --llms-full`, a live keyless skills index.json, and an MCP server that searches Stripe documentation. Missing for 10: no evidence that llms.txt specifically indexes the agentic-commerce section, and no independent confirmation that the agent-oriented docs are deep enough end to end (one community commenter called the MPP page sparse).
